CA.rationale: A candidate-origin processing condition (command_estimate) is explicitly linked to the candidate content red at the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red coordinates), an organization/pattern (large coordinate set), and a separate origin/status entry are present for p0/current/n2/current.

A.rationale: A processing/attention-related condition ('command_estimate') is explicitly associated with the candidate content referent.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers list referents and attributes (red/blue coordinate sets) for current and candidate entries.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is presented separately from the identified content coordinates for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The content is shown as an organized spatial pattern and the coordinate orientation for presentation is stated.
